get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("Ambala" OR "Bahadurgarh" OR "Bhiwani" OR "Fatehabad" OR "Hisar" OR "Hissar" OR "Jhajjar" OR "Jind" OR "Kaithal" OR "Karnal" OR "Kurukshetra" OR "Narnaul" OR "Palwal" OR "Panchkula" OR "Panipat" OR "Rewari" OR "Rohtak" OR "Sirsa" OR "Sonepat" OR "Sonipat" OR "Thanesar" OR "Yamunanagar" OR ("Haryana" AND ("census town" OR "census towns" OR "secondary city" OR "small town" OR "small towns" OR "medium-sized"))) AND ("city" OR "municipal" OR "peri-urban" OR "town" OR "urban" OR "urbanisation" OR "urbanization"))
